name: Freedom Arrow — 0.9 (China)
description: Freedom Arrow 0.9.5-dev.43 (release candidate, not released): 0.9.5-dev.41 plus NLOS rounds at a spot without a unit fly to it with seeker None (Iskander-K style); dev.42 was a local test only; 0.9.5-dev.40 = 0.9.5-dev.39 plus NLOS laser-spot distance; 0.9.5-dev.39 = 0.9.5-dev.38 plus Play cards: layout and resting spots agree, no pop (FlyFadeIn snap-back); 0.9.5-dev.38 = 0.9.5-dev.37 plus Play-card fly-in target; 0.9.5-dev.37 = 0.9.5-dev.36 plus live ranked server (Season Alpha), ranked host map by size tag, Mod Lobbies page without group/search, helicopter flares 15 on Z-10K Recon/Z-10 Recon/Mi-8 Cargo, 8x HQ-9C renames the card, Play row centred on screen; 0.9.5-dev.36 = dev.35 plus altitude arrow during strafe/bombing/attack runs; 0.9.5-dev.35 = vanilla icons on the HQ-9 cards, the HJ-10 NLOS loadout and 54 China rounds that still showed placeholders, ZSL-92 MG icon, ranked search status (Expanding search), Play menu fade and centring fixes, altitude arrow hidden during precision strikes. Includes everything in 0.9.4. Needs Freedom Arrow — Models and Music 0.2.62.
